<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){ dataLayer.push(arguments); }
  gtag('consent', 'default', {
    'analytics_storage': 'denied',
    'ad_storage': 'denied',
    'ad_user_data': 'denied',
    'ad_personalization': 'denied',
    'wait_for_update': 500
  });
  </script>

<script>
  (function () {
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      var telLink = event.target.closest('a[href^="tel:"]');
      if (telLink) window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'phone_click', link_url: telLink.getAttribute('href') });

      var waLink = event.target.closest('a[href*="wa.me"]');
      if (waLink) window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'whatsapp_click', link_url: waLink.getAttribute('href') });

      var mainCta = event.target.closest('[data-cta="main"]');
      if (mainCta) window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'main_cta_click', link_url: mainCta.getAttribute('href') || null });
    });

    var form = document.getElementById('adblue-form');
    if (!form) return;

    var statusEl = form.querySelector('[data-form-status]');
    var submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    var formStarted = false;

    form.addEventListener('focusin', function () {
      if (formStarted) return;
      formStarted = true;
      window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'form_start' });
    });

    function setStatus(state, text) {
      if (!statusEl) return;
      statusEl.textContent = text;
      statusEl.setAttribute('data-state', state);
    }

    function clearFieldErrors() {
      form.querySelectorAll('.is-invalid').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('is-invalid'); });
      form.querySelectorAll('.field-error').forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = ''; });
    }

    function showFieldError(field, message) {
      field.classList.add('is-invalid');
      var wrap = field.closest('.form-row');
      if (wrap) {
        var msgEl = wrap.querySelector('.field-error');
        if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = message;
      }
    }

    function validate() {
      clearFieldErrors();
      var firstInvalid = null;

      form.querySelectorAll('input[required], textarea[required]').forEach(function (field) {
        var valid = field.value.trim() !== '';
        if (!valid) {
          showFieldError(field, 'Dieses Feld ist erforderlich.');
          if (!firstInvalid) firstInvalid = field;
        }
      });

      if (firstInvalid) {
        firstInvalid.focus();
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      if (!validate()) {
        setStatus('error', 'Bitte fülle alle Pflichtfelder aus.');
        return;
      }

      var formData = new FormData(form);
      var payload = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());

      if (payload.website) return;

      payload.formName = 'AdBlue-Anfrage';

      setStatus('sending', 'Wird gesendet…');
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

      fetch('/api/send-lead', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      })
        .then(function (response) {
          return response.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (result) {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Versand fehlgeschlagen.');
          });
        })
        .then(function () {
          setStatus('success', 'Vielen Dank für deine Anfrage. Powertech Performance prüft deine Angaben und meldet sich persönlich bei dir.');
          window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'form_submit' });
          form.reset();
        })
        .catch(function () {
          setStatus('error', 'Deine Anfrage konnte nicht gesendet werden. Bitte versuche es erneut oder kontaktiere uns direkt per WhatsApp unter +49 173 7373574.');
        })
        .finally(function () {
          if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
        });
    });
  })();
  </script>
